prompt: Which reads all runtime-visible annotations from a class called 'Service'?
choices: Annotation[] annotations = Service.class.getAnnotations(); for (Annotation a : annotations) System.out.println(a);
explanation: Class.getAnnotations() returns all RUNTIME-retained annotations on the class (including inherited). getDeclaredAnnotations() returns only annotations directly on the class, not inherited ones. Use instanceof or annotation.annotationType() to distinguish specific annotation types.
